findings.detail: bvn length: handler accepts only 10-character values, spec requires exactly 11 (minLength 11, maxLength 11)
findings.evidence: Handler line: `if len(str(body.get("bvn", ""))) != 10:` — rejects any bvn whose length is not 10 (the error text 'bvn must be 11 digits' contradicts the check itself). Spec: bvn has minLength 11 and maxLength 11, so an 11-digit bvn is valid but the handler rejects it, and a 10-digit bvn is invalid but the handler accepts it. (verified: ASSERTION: value for bvn satisfies the documented constraint, but the handler returned 400: {'error': 'bvn must be 11 digits'})
